name: Magnificent 7 — Quarterly Fundamentals Snapshot
description: Cross-sectional summary of the latest quarterly income statement data for the Magnificent 7 stocks. Shows Diluted EPS, Revenue ($B), Revenue QoQ and YoY growth, and EBITDA ($B). All values reflect the most recent quarterly filing.
source:
# --- Magnificent 7: Quarterly Fundamentals Snapshot ---
# Pulls latest quarterly income statement for each study asset.
# Displays EPS, Revenue ($B), QoQ/YoY revenue growth, EBITDA ($B).

# --- Data ---
inc = income_statement(period=BalanceSheetTimeframe.quarterly)

# --- Derived Metrics ---
# Diluted EPS (raw dollars)
eps = inc.diluted_eps

# Revenue in billions USD
rev_bn = inc.revenue / 1e9

# Revenue QoQ growth: (rev - rev_prev) / rev_prev
rev_prev = inc.revenue >> 1
rev_qoq = (inc.revenue - rev_prev) / rev_prev

# Revenue YoY growth: (rev - rev_4q_ago) / rev_4q_ago
rev_4q = inc.revenue >> 4
rev_yoy = (inc.revenue - rev_4q) / rev_4q

# EBITDA in billions USD
ebitda_bn = inc.ebitda / 1e9

# --- Output ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Magnificent 7 — Latest Quarterly Financials',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='Fundamentals',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Quarterly Income Statement',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Diluted EPS ($)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Revenue ($B)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rev QoQ Growth', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rev YoY Growth', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='EBITDA ($B)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(eps, rev_bn, rev_qoq, rev_yoy, ebitda_bn)
